 About the match
 On this page you can find the Port FC vs Beijing Guoan match lineup for AFC Champions League Elite — Round 4, on Tuesday 03-11-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Port FC lines up in a 4-4-2 led by Phala, while Beijing Guoan sets up in a 4-4-2 led by Zhang. Port FC is led by head coach Bozidar Bandovic, while Beijing Guoan is managed by Nick Montgomery. The match is played at BG Stadium.
